items.label: Harness Object
items.value: The Rear Legs support Harness is designed to help your elderly, disabled, or injured dog, who are unable to navigate the stairs, has a difficult time getting up and down, needs help walking and at any risk of falling

items.label: Lifesaver
items.value: The dog carrying harness can pick up the rear end of your fur friend,prevent hip pain and injury caused by aging, support them getting in and out of the car,up and down the steps,help them get up from lying down,stabilize both the gait and spine

items.label: Postoperative Rehabilitation
items.value: This Hip lifter is a helpful rehabilitation strap to help your furry pug who are post-op surgery of knee,CCL (ACL),TPLO,hip replacement and so on.They all have some trouble with the their back legs

items.label: Soft Durable
items.value: Inside contains synthetic fleece material，the dog mobility harness is very fluffy and comfortable for your dog to wear,won't chafe your pups underbelly. The belly sling carrier outer cove with oxford fabric, it is sturdy for large dog

items.label: Easy to Use
items.value: The concept of the portable dog lift support harness is great with the padded handles,so its cushion works great for all dog owners can give your dog a assist lifting with easy.The dog body hoist is washable and easy to carry or storage with drawstring bag when not use it

items.label: Size
items.value: This style has a adjustable length strap and is suitable for medium to large dogs with a adjustable length of 49-68 inches
